result.brief: 提出 IVT 后训练框架，在无标注视频上联合优化文本预测与下一嵌入预测，将预测式世界建模内化到训练中，推理时直接作答，无需生成未来帧，兼顾主动视频推理的准确性与效率。
result.reason: Internalized next-embedding prediction over unlabeled videos for proactive video reasoning; predictive world modeling internalized in training, latent future-frame prediction, no pixel generation at inference.
